description: FIXTURE THEME -- the profile the stub Pixelcoat repo carries so the fixture install is a WORKING one. Every fixture batch names theme_family delco_1997; before the theme preflight (LF 0.51.0, roadmap 72) nothing asked whether the profile existed, so this directory did not need to. It does now: `run` refuses an art layer whose theme does not resolve, which is the whole point of the feature, and a stub install that cannot resolve its own theme fails seven tests for a content reason rather than a pipeline one. Shape copied from the real pixelcoat/profiles/themes/delco.json, not invented -- the preflight only checks the file is THERE, but a fixture that lies about its schema is a trap for whoever reads it next.
